classification_rules.ALLOW: Symbol in USE sheet → extract=true, scope_status=IN_SCOPE
classification_rules.BLOCK: Symbol in DO_NOT_USE sheet → extract=false, scope_status=OUT_OF_SCOPE
classification_rules.UNSPECIFIED: Symbol not found in either → extract=true, scope_status=UNSPECIFIED, flag=NO_SCOPE_DEFINITION_FOUND

downstream_usage.tag_detection: Filter detected symbols against blocked_names before OCR
downstream_usage.ocr_agent: Skip OCR for BLOCK symbols, mark as OUT_OF_SCOPE
downstream_usage.assembly_agent: Drop OUT_OF_SCOPE tags from final output
